en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 36. And with the former chains of narration from ‘Ali ibn Mahyzar from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, that: Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, said:

"When you are determined to do something good, then do not delay doing it. For when Allah, Most Glorious, sees His slave intent upon performing an act according to one of His commands, He says: ’By My Might and Greatness, I shall never subject you to any chastisement.’

And when you feel inclined to commit a sin, do not do it, for when Allah, Most Benevolent and High, finds a slave on the verge of committing a sin, He says: ’By My Might and Greatness, I will never forgive you.’"
